text: dsh-client-ui-brand 是面向 DSH Web 的品牌定制插件，可替换侧边栏产品名称、品牌图标和浏览器标题。它通过 Web 服务端注入配置，并在客户端占用侧边栏名称、侧边栏图标与会话欢迎区域的品牌图标插槽。配置标志后，还会更新 favicon 和 PWA manifest，并为图标生成保持比例的方形画布。可使用 HTTPS、同源或 data 图片 URL，也可配置本地图像路径；产品名和替代文本均可自定义。适合希望为 DSH Web 部署设置独立产品外观的用户。无需 API Key；安装到 Web profile 后按需添加品牌配置。

dsh-client-ui-brand customizes DSH Web branding: the sidebar name and mark, browser title, favicon, and PWA manifest. It injects server configuration into client brand slots and supports HTTPS, same-origin, data, or local image sources. Operators can give a DSH Web deployment its own identity withou
想给自托管的 DSH Web 换成自己的产品名称和图标。
怎么让 DSH 侧边栏显示自定义品牌名？
我想替换 Web 界面的默认机器人标志。
让浏览器标签页标题跟着我的产品名称显示。
能否给 DSH Web 配一个自己的 favicon 和 PWA 图标？
希望用本地图片文件作为 DSH 品牌图标。
Can I rebrand the DSH Web sidebar and browser title?
I want my own logo and PWA icon in a DSH web deployment.
dsh-client-ui-brand 的功能「侧边栏品牌」：把配置的产品名称和图标放入 DSH Web 侧边栏品牌插槽。插件从启动时注入的品牌配置生成名称与图标组件，并保留宿主插槽提供的尺寸。
dsh-client-ui-brand 的功能「浏览器标题」：将页面标题中的产品后缀替换为配置名称，并监听标题 DOM 变化以维持该后缀。未含分隔符的标题会改为产品名称。
dsh-client-ui-brand 的功能「浏览器与 PWA 图标」：配置标志后生成方形 SVG 图标并提供 PWA manifest，替换 Web Shell 的 favicon 和 manifest 链接；未配置标志时保留默认链接。
dsh-client-ui-brand 的功能「本地图标」：读取配置的本地图片并通过固定品牌图标路由提供；路径须为绝对路径，文件须为受支持扩展名的普通文件。
dsh-client-ui-brand 使用前须知：配置 HTTPS 标志地址时，服务端会请求图片并嵌入图标元数据；同源或 data 地址不走此下载逻辑。（见 src/index.ts:100-105、164-173）
dsh-client-ui-brand README · Introduction：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-client-ui-brand README · dsh-client-ui-brand：This is a simple DeepSeek Harness plugin. It customizes product branding
without changing DeepSeek Harness source code.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · What it changes：The plugin displays configured marks with centered, proportional fitting in the
Web interface. It separately wraps every favicon and PWA icon in a square,
transparent SVG canvas, so non-square marks do not stretch. HTTPS images are
downloaded by the plugin and embedded into browser metadata, so favicon
renderers never need a nested external image request. DSH's runtime session
title remains visible and ends with the configured product name.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · What it changes：DSH Core does not currently provide an accepted slot for the empty-conversation
slogan. This plugin therefore cannot change it without an intrusive
modification; it can support the slogan when DSH Core exposes that slot.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Install：Install the published package into the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-brand
```

Restart the DSH Web process after installation.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Configure：Add a later Web profile patch, usually at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
```

The installed bundle already uses **Brand New Agent** and its default Agent
mark. Every configuration field is optional. Add this later profile patch only
when overriding the defaults:

```yaml
- id: dsh-client-ui-brand
  config:
    productName: Acme Agent
    logoUrl: https://cdn.example.com/branding/acme-agent.svg

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Configuration fields：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `productName` | `Brand New Agent` | Sidebar product name, browser title, and PWA name. |
| `logoUrl` | Not set | HTTPS URL, same-origin absolute path, or `data:image/...` URL for the logo, favicon, and PWA icon. |
| `logoPath` | Not set | Absolute path to one local image served by DSH for the logo, favicon, and PWA icon. |
| `logoAlt` | `productName` | Accessible logo text. |

Configure either `logoUrl` or `logoPath`, not both.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Local logo：```yaml
- id: dsh-client-ui-brand
  config:
    productName: Acme Agent
    logoPath: /absolute/path/to/acme-agent-logo.svg

The local file is exposed only through the fixed route:

```text
/plugins/dsh-client-ui-brand/brand-logo
```

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Local logo：When a logo is configured, the plugin serves the square brand image at
`/plugins/dsh-client-ui-brand/brand-mark.svg`, generates a PWA manifest at
`/plugins/dsh-client-ui-brand/manifest.webmanifest`, and replaces the Web
Shell's favicon and manifest links. Without a configured logo, the Web Shell
keeps its default favicon and manifest.

dsh-client-ui-brand README · Local logo：For safety, the path must be an absolute, non-symlink regular file with a
`gif`, `jpeg`, `jpg`, `png`, `svg`, or `webp` extension. The route accepts only
`GET` and `HEAD`, never accepts a request-controlled file path, returns `404`
when the configured file cannot be read, and sends `no-store` and `nosniff`
headers.
